### Will We Remember Our Sin in Heaven? (Isaiah 43:25) - Your Daily Bible Verse - June 29
Author: Matt Fuller
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/will-we-remember-our-sin-in-heaven-bible-study-minute-september-11-2017.html
Passage: Isaiah 43:25
Points:
- In heaven, believers will be entirely perfected and permanently freed from the inward battle against sin.
- Our devotion to Christ will be wholehearted and passionate, without spiritual dryness or doubt.
- Fellowship among believers will be completely harmonious, free of offense and envy.
- God choosing not to remember our transgressions means He has decisively dealt with their guilt and penalty.
- Any future recollection of our past will evoke gratitude for God's grace rather than painful shame.
